name: Any Roblox Game!
desc:
🔎 Finds a random game created by a random Robloxian and teleports you to it!

💸 Credits goes to any game owner that the game picks! :)

✨New games added weekly! ✨

Disclaimer: This group is NOT to be responsible for any games that updates itself adding inappropriate content to it. If you notice anything against the Roblox TOS, please report it immediately! Thank you for your understanding!
